sub_indicators.label: Interoperability of social protection systems
sub_indicators.subject: dpi.exchange
sub_indicators.text: Interoperability of social protection systems: interoperability of social protection systems
sub_indicators.norm_short: The African Union's Protocol on Social Protection asks for a social protection information system that works with the ID, civil registration, payments and other sectors, so benefits follow the person.
criteria: A source from the past three years says social protection programmes keep separate lists with no exchange between them or with other systems.
A link from a registry or programme to the national ID, a payment provider or another programme is contracted, being built or piloted.
A social registry or programme system exchanges data with the national ID, a payment provider or another programme in use.
Two or more programmes draw their beneficiaries from a shared social registry.
The registry is linked to the national ID and to civil registration, health, education or tax.

aspects.name: Linked to the ID and another sector
